program.text: 3-day workshop. Objectives: move beyond thickness-only seal evaluation to cover rock mineralogy/lithofacies, brittle-ductile behavior, hydrocarbon phase/column height, structural reactivation/tilted fluid contacts, pressure regimes, CO2 storage seal assessment. Oral presentations and posters.
